mapper.select: select count(settlement_status) from personal_settlement where settlement_status = '정산대기'
select sum(amount) from personal_settlement where settlement_status = '정산대기'

select m.personal_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from personal_settlement s join personal_match m on s.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id order by m.match_date desc

select m.personal_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from personal_settlement s join personal_match m on s.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id where s.settlement_status = '정산대기' order by m.match_date desc

select m.personal_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from personal_settlement s join personal_match m on s.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id where s.settlement_status = '지급완료' order by match_date desc

select m.personal_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from personal_settlement s join personal_match m on s.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id where m.match_date = #{targetDate} order by m.match_date desc

select m.personal_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, u.nickname, u.account_holder, s.settlement_id, s.bank_name, s.account_number, s.amount, s.settlement_status from personal_settlement s join personal_match m on s.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id join user u on s.user_id = u.user_id where s.personal_match_id = #{personalMatchId}
